meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动的方式构建功能或修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写测试再写代码，或需要提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Build features or fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before code or need to improve code quality

howto.what: Claude 会引导你按照红-绿-重构循环进行测试驱动开发：先写一个会失败的测试，再写刚好能通过的代码，然后进入代码审查阶段。它还会帮你写出好的测试，避免常见反模式。
howto.when: 当你想先写测试再开发功能、提到“红-绿-重构”或需要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 我想用TDD方式添加一个用户注册功能。
say.note: Claude会引导你从写测试开始。

say.text: 帮我检查这个测试是不是耦合了实现细节。
say.note: Claude会分析测试是否依赖内部结构。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through the red-green-refactor cycle: write a failing test, then minimal code to pass, then review. It helps write good tests and avoid anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to build features or fix bugs test-first, mention "red-green-refactor", or want integration tests.

say_en.text: I want to add a user registration feature using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you starting with a test.

say_en.text: Check if this test is coupled to implementation details.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the test for internal dependencies.
